model_policy.pricing: Peak-rate estimates from the registered Pi model config; not billing reconciliation. Official pricing also has off-peak discounts.
model_policy.alias: Reuse the original mutable deepseek-flash alias; no identical backend checkpoint claim across dates.

budget_policy: Original task-native agent timeouts, original resources, and 1800-second setup. Stock Pi loop and generation behavior: no injected 100-turn cap or 180-second finalization reminder. Model metadata maxTokens=384000 is preserved from the local provider configuration. This differs from the historical Nano baseline (100 replies, 65536 requested output tokens, native timeout minus 180 seconds for work), so this is an agent baseline rather than a matched-budget causal comparison. Temperature unset.
verifier_policy: Original official tests and native per-attempt timeouts. Only verifier timeouts retry, at most three total attempts on the same output. No dependency-error recovery or whole-trial retry. Preserve setup errors and verifier errors separately from scored failures.
preflight_policy: Use the completed, hash-bound WAL install-only trial from the initial pair; its dependency profile is not_configured and restricted-v1 network controls passed. The formal job repeats setup and network controls in a fresh container. Pipeline remains independently gated by its own preflight.
information_policy: One fresh attempt per previously reference-exposed task. Use PR #57 restricted-v1 rules shared by all supported agents and external egress enforcement. Only api.deepseek.com is allowed during model work; no package, documentation, code-hosting, or search hosts are permitted. Install/preflight and official verifier retain native public network. No historical cache Compose overlays. Preserve original task bytes, images, package sources, resources, and deadlines. Do not supply previous trajectories or reference material. Freeze outputs before reviewing trajectories, tests, and violations; preserve raw rewards and errors. Report violations separately as effective zeroes, blocked attempts separately from successful retrieval, and unreviewed trials as pending. This selected restricted supplement cannot be pooled with historical open-network baselines.
authorization: Maintainer requested a new branch and rerunning the previously cheating Pi tasks using the previous PR, preserving only necessary network access and checking whether violations recur.
amendment: Release each task only after its own installation and network preflight passes, without waiting for its sibling. The initial pair preflight continues; the original combined model queue is superseded and must not run. No model call has occurred before this amendment. Both original single-attempt job names, configs, source, policies, resources, and deadlines are unchanged; at most two task containers run concurrently. No new trajectories are reviewed until both tasks are finished or recorded as setup failures.
